feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 23 October 2026 5:43pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 23 October 2026 at 5:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Strong northwest winds at first bringing a few showers across central to northern parts of the island at first, but as the winds turn more westerly later this evening the showers will clear leaving the rest of the evening and overnight largely dry. Winds will also ease moderate to fresh overnight and gradually becoming a south-westerly. Minimum temperature around 8°C.


##Outlook##

A period of rain will arrive early tomorrow morning, persistent and heavy at times, before clearing early in the evening. Fresh southerly winds at first will increase to become gale force around midday, then severe gale force during the evening, giving gusts of 60-70mph overnight into Sunday, causing some damage and disruption to travel. Maximum temperature around 14°C.

Very windy on Sunday with sunny spells and isolated showers. The west to southwest winds severe gale force to start then easing slightly during the morning but still remaining gale force until the evening, before a more significant decrease overnight into Monday.
